text:
maria (support): Heads-up — multiple APAC customers reporting repeated SSE disconnects and truncated outputs since ~07:12 UTC. Ticket #INC-2431 attached. Customers see reconnect loops and partial last-token truncation.

maria (support): Typical report: client receives a few event chunks, then connection drops. Client reconnects and resumes but some responses are duplicated or truncated. Billing complaints mixed in — customers say tokens counted twice when reconnect happens mid-stream.

anya (eng-runtime): Thanks. Do we have any correlation with recent ingress or keepalive change? I see a small rollout yesterday for HTTP/2 ping tuning in apac-edge (deploy v2026-03-15-keepalive).

jordan (oncall): Paging SRE. @kai can you take? Some customers in ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1.

incidents-bot: PagerDuty incident triggered: PD-7768 assigned to jordan.

kai (sre): Looking. Initial hypothesis: keepalive probe frequency + client reconnect backoff are interacting — the edge is sending a probe that occasionally closes stream mid-frame when p99 latency spikes happen. That can cause the client to reconnect with last-event-id and we might be double-charging if billing counts received chunks on reconnect.

leo (eng-platform): I’m seeing elevated 5xx's from apac-edge LB at 07:10-07:30 UTC, connection reset by peer spikes. Traces: loadbalancer/edge-01 -> runtime-12.

anya (eng-runtime): Querying runtime logs for partial-output events and aborted streams. Snippet from runtime logs: ```
[07:14:02] runtime-12 stream_start session=abc123 model=redwood/opt-7b
[07:14:07] runtime-12 write_chunk len=512 seq=5 session=abc123
[07:14:07] runtime-12 connection_reset: keepalive_probe_timeout
[07:14:07] runtime-12 session_mark_partial session=abc123
```

maria (support): Customer repro steps I got:
1) curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -N "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/stream?model=opt-7b" 
2) wait ~10s after response starts, lots of small chunks show up, then connection drops with no final [DONE] event. Client auto-reconnects and gets partial result repeated.

(They included client-side logs showing `ERR_SSE_ABORTED` and `last-event-id` present)

kai (sre): Repro locally with a test harness: confirmed that when edge LB emits a TCP RST during an in-flight frame we observe this exact behavior. Also saw client reconnect jitter causing a second request that completes and biller microservice counts tokens twice.

anya (eng-runtime): Possible immediate mitigations:
- Adjust edge keepalive probe to be less aggressive (increase timeout).
- Route APAC streaming requests to eu-west fallback pool (higher latency but reliable).
- Temporarily disable token-increment on incomplete streams until finalization (requires quick patch to billing pipeline) — dangerous for revenue but reduces false double-charge.

leo (eng-platform): I can push a routing override to send streaming traffic from apac to eu-west for canary subset (10%). Will take 10-15m.

jordan (oncall): Do it. Also prepare status update copy.

maria (support): Suggested status page text draft:
"We are investigating reports of streaming interruptions affecting some customers in APAC. Engineers are investigating and routing changes are being applied to mitigate impact. We will provide updates within 30 minutes. If you see truncated output or duplicate token charges, please open a support ticket and include request-id and timestamps."

kai (sre): Working on a short-term fix: bump keepalive timeout on apac-edge from 10s -> 30s and pause the HTTP/2 ping rollout. That should reduce mid-frame RSTs. Implementing as config change to edge fleet (no full deploy).

deploy-bot: Edge config update proposed: keepalive_timeout=30s for fleet apac-edge. Change set cs-9123.

anya (eng-runtime): Also enabling a server-side guard: on reconnection, check last-event-id and if session is marked partial, reconcile token accounting by consulting session KV. Will push a small hotfix to billing reconciliation (non-invasive, runtime guard). Patch PR #2587 ready for canary.

kai (sre): Changes applied to 10% canary in ap-southeast-1. Monitoring p99 disconnects.

leo (eng-platform): Canary routing override live. ~12% of streaming traffic now routed to eu-west fallback via region-route v2.

maria (support): Notifying customers: sending update to INC-2431 and customer mailing list with status page link.

anya (eng-runtime): Observability: added a metric stream_disconnect_reason and a tag for mid-frame-abort. Initial graphs show a 65% drop in mid-frame aborts on canary hosts.

kai (sre): After keepalive config change and canary, disconnect rate in apac dropped from 3.4% -> 0.9% within 12 minutes. Billing duplicate events reported by test harness stopped.

jordan (oncall): Good. Plan for next 30m: expand keepalive change to remainder of apac-edge, keep routing override for 10% as safety, hold billing change in review. If metrics stay green, rollback earlier HTTP/2 ping tuning permanently.

maria (support): Drafting a customer-facing post for the status page and CS teams. Will include repro mitigation (use non-stream endpoint as workaround: POST /v1/generate with streaming=false).

anya (eng-runtime): Follow-up action items:
- Retro of keepalive rollout - disable until more tests.
- Add integration test for mid-frame probe interaction.
- Add billing reconciliation to protect against double-charge on reconnect.

kai (sre): Will watch for regressions. If we see a resurgence, escalate to full rollback of the keepalive feature and start PG investigation.

incidents-bot: Incident PD-7768 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria (support): Update to customers posted to status.redwood-inference.com: "Mitigation applied; customers in APAC seeing reduced interruptions. Engineering continuing to monitor. If you still see issues, please reply to your ticket with request-id and sample curl output."

jordan (oncall): Thanks everyone. Leave this thread open for any late reports. We'll update when we widen rollout or close.

kai (sre): Logging final note: root cause appears to be an interaction between aggressive edge keepalive probes and transient p99 latency causing mid-frame RSTs -> client reconnect -> duplicate billing events. Patch path: tune keepalive, add runtime reconciliation, add billing guard.

maria (support): Closing loop with customer contacts now. Will reopen if they report new problems.

leo (eng-platform): Patching playbook with checklist for future keepalive rollouts.

anya (eng-runtime): PR #2587 merged to canary billing-recon guard, will promote after 2h of stable metrics.

jordan (oncall): last update here at 08:55 UTC — monitoring. If stable for 2h, we'll resolve. Thanks all.
